name: Find OOX-22/FE!
summary: A homing robot has crashed in Feralas, and Oglethorpe Obnoticus calls for help through a strange metal egg. Carry its beacon to a cave near Feral Scar Vale.

sections.title: A Voice in the Egg
sections.body: Turn the knob on the metal egg, and it opens into a gnomish contraption. Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks from within. His homing robot has crashed, and he promises payment if you recover it. He has worked out that the machine lies in a cave near Feral Scar Vale. Carry the beacon there.

sections.title: What the Cave Holds
sections.body: A robotic chicken lies wrecked in the cave. Oglethorpe Obnoticus confirms it is his homing robot. It needs a jump-start before it can fly to Booty Bay for repairs. Place the beacon inside, and the robot whirs to life. Then Oglethorpe's voice comes from the robot itself.

faq.q: Who is speaking through the distress beacon?
faq.answer: Oglethorpe Obnoticus speaks through the beacon. His homing robot has crashed, and he asks you to bring the beacon to it.

faq.q: Where does the beacon point you to go?
faq.answer: The beacon points to a cave near Feral Scar Vale in Feralas. Oglethorpe has worked out the robot's coordinates.
The beacon is a strange egg-shaped metal device. Turn its knob, and it opens into a gnomish contraption with a voice inside.
